rules.slot: (tag u16, n0 u8, n1 u8); h = corpus_memory._finalise(ctx * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15 + node * 0xC2B2AE3D27D4EB4F): slot = top log2 bits, tag = low 16 bits; empty = n0 + n1 == 0
rules.update: per training position in corpus order, 8 nodes root first: empty or same tag -> use; other tag -> evict (tag replaced, counts 0); then: if n_b == 255 halve both; n_b += 1; if n_other > 2: n_other = n_other // 2 + 1
rules.lookup: beam of width 4 over the observed bits (n_bit > 0), p(bit) = (n_bit + 0.4) / (n0 + n1 + 0.8), stable ties; any node read that is empty or holds another tag -> miss for the whole lookup; top / second = the two best complete paths
rules.false_hit: a hit at a held-out position whose exact context (64-bit hash) never occurs in the training bytes
